basic_info.description: Step into a world where historic charm meets modern luxury. This rarely available 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence is nestled within a luxury boutique original warehouse conversion, offering a unique blend of classic elegance and contemporary design. Imagine living amidst the rich character of exposed concrete, the warmth of bamboo hardwood floors, and the expansive feel of soaring 11-foot ceilings with floor-to-ceiling windows that bathe your home in natural light. The modern, open-concept kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring a gas range, stainless steel Bosch appliances, and exquisite Studio Becker cabinetry with ample counter space. Beyond your doorstep lies the vibrant allure of the South Park Historic District and Park, a beloved neighborhood gem where locals gather to enjoy the fresh air and sunshine. This urban sanctuary is not only a haven of tranquility but also offers the utmost convenience with one parking space and an in-unit washer/dryer. Experience unparalleled walkability to an array of amenities and seamless access to transportation, putting the best of San Francisco at your fingertips.Ready to experience sophisticated city living in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods?
